body_long:
Some guests check in once. Zinédine Zidane has been coming back to Palace Merano for about thirty years. He first came in 1996, brought by Henri Chenot, and has returned ever since.

This autumn, as the hotel celebrated its 120th anniversary, the city of Merano chose to thank him in public.

## A weekend for 120 years

The celebrations opened on Friday 9 October 2026 with a crossover concert at the Teatro Puccini, between opera and pop, with the Fondazione Luciano Pavarotti, presided by Nicoletta Mantovani. Three young performers took the stage: the tenor Francesco Lucii, the soprano Eva Macaggi and the pop singer Enrico Zoni.

The next morning, at the Pavillon des Fleurs, Zidane was interviewed by the sports journalist Stefano Bizzotto. The city then gave him an official recognition, proposed by Deputy Mayor Nerio Zaccaria, and an artwork by Ulrich Egger. Young players from the local football schools came for autographs and selfies.

## A house built on health

Palace Merano opened in March 1906. Today it is known as one of Italy's leading medical spas, built around its Revital method and a 6,000 square metre centre. The house is led by CEO Stefano Plotegher and general manager Maximilian Newiger, with Dr Massimiliano Mayrhofer as scientific director.

Zidane is one of the hotel's ambassadors, alongside the Olympic champions Deborah Compagnoni and Alex Schwazer. Schwazer supervises the Sport Recovery Lab, which offers biomechanical, postural, metabolic and cognitive assessments and a fitness area equipped by Technogym.

## The signal

No campaign can buy thirty years of loyalty. Palace Merano did not sign a famous face: it kept a guest, and the guest became the story.

For hoteliers, the lesson is simple. The most credible ambassador is the one who keeps returning, and a long relationship with a guest can be worth more than any advertising.

Congratulations to Palace Merano and its teams on 120 years.
summary: For the 120th anniversary of Palace Merano, the city of Merano honoured Zinédine Zidane, a guest of the house since 1996 and now one of its ambassadors.
